what: FYI, contract question, nothing blocks: blaze-query-macros query.rs:245 requires Hash of the value of every lru query, also with no_eq, where a recomputed value is never compared, so the hash looks unused. qu-check8 hit it on hir-ty-codegen mod.rs inlinable/always_inlinable (no_eq, lru = 0, Option<Inlinable> not Hash).
